drafts.title: Customer migration to EKS Fargate across 3 FSI accounts
drafts.description: Three financial services customers (Bank A, Bank B, Insurance C) independently migrated container workloads from self-managed EKS to Fargate in Q1. Common driver: reducing operational overhead for PCI-DSS compliance. Average migration time: 6 weeks. All reported 40-60% reduction in cluster management effort.

source.reference: Calendar: FSI Container Strategy Review — Apr 1

drafts.title: OpenSearch Serverless pricing concern blocking adoption
drafts.description: Customer raised concern about OpenSearch Serverless OCU minimum pricing during architecture review. Current self-managed cluster costs $2.1K/month; Serverless minimum would be $3.5K/month for their usage pattern. Evaluating alternatives.
